Problem.content: Paper memperkenalkan dataset LFQA keuangan pertama dan melakukan benchmark komprehensif untuk menilai kemampuan model dalam menjawab pertanyaan keuangan.
Problem.quote: introducing the first LFQA financial dataset and conducting comprehensive benchmark experiments

Domain & Data.content: Dataset berfokus pada domain keuangan, mencakup dokumen teks buku, regulasi, dan kebijakan dari sumber seperti HKMA, EU, dan Federal Reserve; berisi 1.262 pasangan QA dalam bahasa Inggris.

RAG Method.content: Menggunakan empat embedder (Bge‑small‑en‑v1.5, Gte‑large, Ember‑v1, Ada), tiga retriever (AMR, SWR, vector‑based), tiga reranker (LLMRerank, Bge‑Reranker‑Base, All‑Mpnet‑Base‑v2), serta generator LLM termasuk Baichuan2‑7B.
RAG Method.quote: We adopt four popular embedding models... We explore three retriever methods... examine the influence of three rerankers

Evaluation & Metrics.content: Evaluasi menggunakan metrik otomatis ROUGE‑1/2/L, BLEU, serta skor GPT‑4 yang menilai kegunaan, relevansi, akurasi, kedalaman, dan kreativitas; juga melibatkan penilaian manusia dengan skala 1‑5.
Evaluation & Metrics.quote: ROUGE and BLEU are used to automatically measure... GPT‑4 scoring method is used to evaluate the answers

Main Results.content: Embedder Ada mencapai skor GPT‑4 tertinggi 4.586; retriever AMR memperoleh 4.492; kombinasi AMR, Ada, Bge‑Reranker‑Base menghasilkan skor tertinggi 4.622. Generator pada dataset regulasi memperoleh ROUGE‑1 0.317 dan GPT‑4 4.238.
Main Results.quote: Ada2, achieving a score of 4.586... AMR outperforms the rest with an impressive score of 4.492... ROUGE‑1 scores are 0.317 and 0.270, respectively; the GPT‑4 scores are 4.238 and 4.293

Limitations.content: Dataset memiliki jumlah pasangan QA yang relatif kecil dibandingkan dataset AI‑generated besar, sehingga dapat memengaruhi generalisasi; data berkualitas tinggi sulit diperoleh karena hak cipta; belum ada dataset LFQA khusus untuk bahasa Indonesia.
Limitations.quote: FinTextQA contains a relatively smaller number of QA pairs... High‑quality data are challenging to acquire... none of them addresses LFQA

Gap.content: Inferensi: Meskipun FinTextQA menyediakan benchmark LFQA keuangan, penelitian ini tidak mengevaluasi faithfulness atau kemampuan abstention pada dokumen produk perbankan berbahasa Indonesia, sehingga belum menjawab fokus riset yang diusulkan.

However, it is impor- tant to note that there is currently no LFQA dataset specifically tailored for the finance domain. Ex- isting financial QA benchmarks often fall short in addressing question complexity and variety by pri- marily on sentiment analysis and numerical calcula- tion, as comprehensive paragraph-length responses and relevant document retrievals are often required to answer intricate, open-domain questions (Han et al., 2023). RAG Method.text: cost- efficient indexing, retrieval, and generation, al- beit with certain constraints. Advanced RAG ad- dresses these limitations by integrating refined in- dexing and retrieval techniques, optimizing data handling, and introducing strategic Retrieval and post-retrieval processes. Its capabilities include fine-tuning domain-specific embedders, employing dynamic ones for improved context comprehen- sion, and applying reranker and prompt compres- sion during post-retrieval processes (Ilin, 2023). Modular RAG represents a further advancement from traditional NLP frameworks by introducing specialized modules for similarity-based retrieval, fine-tuning, and problem-solving. he Embedder Module The role of the embed- der module is to convert human language into a vector representation that can be understood and processed by computers. In our experiments, we adopt four popular embedding models that have achieved high rankings on the Hugging Face leader- board, including (1) BAAI’s Bge-small-en-v1.5 (Xiao and Liu, 2023), (2) NLPer’s Gte-large (Li et al., 2023), (3) LLMRails’ Ember-v16, and (4) OpenAI’s Ada27. The Retriever Module The retriever module forms the backbone of our experiment by search- ing and retrieving relevant context related to a given question. We explore three retriever methods, including Auto Merging Retriever (AMR) (Liu, 2023), (2) Sentence Window Retriever (SWR) (lla- maindex, 2023), and a simple vector-based retriever approach. The Reranker Module The primary objective of rerankers is to refine the retrieved information by repositioning the most pertinent content towards the prompt edges. To accomplish this, we examine the influence of three rerankers on the overall sys- tem performance: (1) LLMRerank (Fajardo, 2023), (2) Bge-Ranker-Base8, and (3) All-Mpnet-Base- v2(Song et al., 2020). The Generator Module The generator module first consolidates the query and relevant document context prepared by the former modules into a well- structured and coherent prompt. Our results suggest that the most effective combination of models and modules for finance-related LFQA tasks includes Ada2, AMR, Bge-Reranker-Base, and Baichuan2-7B. Limitations Despite its expert curation and high quality, Fin- TextQA contains a relatively smaller number of QA pairs compared to larger AI-generated datasets. This limitation could potentially affect the gener- alizability of models trained on it when applied to broader real-world applications. High-quality data are challenging to acquire, and copyright re- strictions often prevent sharing. . 2 Related Work 2.1 Long-Form Question Answering (LFQA) Compared to the conventional question-answering task (Bouziane et al., 2015; Mao et al., 2023; Yang et al., 2023b; Cao et al., 2021; Cheng et al., 2023d, 2024), the goal of LFQA is to generate compre- hensive, paragraph-length responses by retrieving and assimilating relevant information from various sources (Fan et al., 2019). This poses a signif- icant test for current Natural Language Process- ing (NLP) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) models, given their limited understanding and learning ca- pacities (Thompson et al., 2020; Cao et al., 2022; Zhang et al., 2023; Cheng et al., 2023b,c; Cheng, 2021).
